summary: PRESERVATION FAILED, decisively. checkpoint-2000 scored 0/15 with the overlay OFF and 0/15 with it ON, against a committed base-model baseline of 8/15 (53.3%, CI [30.1%, 75.2%]) on the same pinned scenes through the same code path. 2000 steps of fine-tuning did not merely fail to help -- it destroyed the policy on this task. Ruled out as causes: (a) serving the wrong weights -- the server log names checkpoint-2000 explicitly; (b) a normalization artifact -- action.end_effector_position, end_effector_rotation and gripper_close statistics are BYTE-IDENTICAL between the checkpoint and the base model; (c) an extraction bug -- both artifacts record 15 booleans for 15 episodes through the runner fixed in EV-0005. The overlay arm being equally dead means the mark cannot rescue a broken policy, which is uninformative about grounding.
